source.license_note: No repository license declared; source equations and parameters are re-expressed; no upstream source code copied

adaptation.observation: exact full state (time,y,z) before each action
adaptation.missing_observation_policy: unsupported; missing observations do not reveal or reconstruct hidden state
adaptation.controller_reset: fresh stateless policy and initial state per disturbance history
adaptation.warm_start: none; finite plans restart from the authored catalogue and every QP solve uses a fresh workspace
adaptation.decision_order: observe full state; select u; apply current v; advance
adaptation.moving_horizon_prediction: source dynamics continue beyond scored episode endpoint

tie_selector.finite_action: first plan in authored action order within 1e-12 absolute objective tolerance
tie_selector.linear_qp: secondary minimum-squared-control QP constrained to primary epigraph optimum plus 1e-7

adaptation.deadline_enforcement: adapter receives the deadline; late returns are rejected, and native factorization cancellation is cooperative
adaptation.fallback: apply u=0 after timeout/solver failure, count the decision, continue the episode
adaptation.stability_scope: finite episode outcomes only; no recursive feasibility or stability theorem

objective.planning: terminal squared max-coordinate objective; zero nominal disturbance or complete finite-history robust constraint

qp.objective: terminal squared max-coordinate via scalar epigraph
qp.robust_plan_semantics: one common open-loop control vector constrained against every complete finite disturbance history; execute first action and replan after full-state observation
qp.tie_selector: second QP minimizes sum(u_i^2) subject to primary epigraph <= optimum + 1e-7
qp.warm_start: none; each primary and tie solve uses a fresh workspace

measurement.timing_scope: Each native process runs all policies in an alternating forward/reverse controller order. Decision timing includes planner problem setup and solver calls, not process startup, JSON output, independent replay, or rendering. Provider registration/setup and whole-process elapsed time are recorded separately.

host.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 5 3550H with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx

scope: finite-action and continuous-control QP, four-step source-derived adaptation; not a reproduction of the continuous-action four-second RL task; finite disturbance histories only
